Conversation content on Day 53: [|User|]: Can you please tell me what the NBME and ExamMaster tests are and why Saint James School of Medicine requires students to pass them in order to take the USMLE Step 1?
[|AI|]: The NBME (National Board of Medical Examiners) and ExamMaster tests are both medical assessment tools used to evaluate a student's learning progress and knowledge level. Saint James School of Medicine requires students to pass these tests with a 650 or above on the NBME and a 75% or above on the ExamMaster in order to take the USMLE Step 1. This is because passing these exams demonstrates that students possess the appropriate knowledge and skills that are necessary to successfully pass the USMLE Step 1. The USMLE Step 1 is an important exam and passing it is a requirement for medical students in the United States to proceed forward with their medical education and training.
